title: Geometric block repetition and selected-extension factorization
statement:
Let X,Y be schemes, f:X→Y a morphism, c a compactification, and l a natural number. There exists a projection Theory T on c such that, for every coefficient tower B, order embedding r of the natural numbers, and local normalized selected extensions Lx,Ly, there are a CofinalRepeatSupport R, two CofinalFactor comparisons Fx,Fy, and CofinalBlockEvaluation data. All notions other than CofinalBlockEvaluation are those of [def-pur-etale-system-cofinal-data]. The new evaluation data consist of repetition evaluation isomorphisms on X and Y and three commuting diagrams: evaluation of each factor comparison is the selected tensor-level comparison, and evaluation of the repetition/support square is the ordinary compact-support square at the least selected index. This chooses the open-adjoint presentation jointly with the repetition, rather than requiring identity-on-sections comparisons for arbitrary open adjoints. It constructs no selected-extension/support comparison and asserts neither its evaluation nor coefficient-projection invertibility.

Precise Lean statement (notation and universes as in the cited definition):
```lean
theorem etaleCofinalBlockFactorization
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f) (l : ℕ) :
    ∃ T : Theory c l,
      ∀ (B : Coefficients.{u} l) (r : ℕ ↪o ℕ)
        (Lx : CofinalExtension X B r) (Ly : CofinalExtension Y B r),
        ∃ (R : CofinalRepeatSupport T B r)
          (Fx : CofinalFactor X B r Lx R.x (T.scalarX (cofinalCoefficient B r)))
          (Fy : CofinalFactor Y B r Ly R.y (T.scalarY (cofinalCoefficient B r))),
          Nonempty (CofinalBlockEvaluation T B r Lx Ly R Fx Fy)
```

proof.text: construct the ordinary geometric projection theory using the actual sequence-site pushforward and a simultaneous sectionwise extension by zero for all coefficient towers. Choose its evaluation and restriction comparisons by the canonical adjunction mates, as in etaleSystemProjectionTheory_nonempty. This fixes T jointly with its block data; one does not assert literal identity-on-sections comparisons for arbitrary open adjoints. For any local normalized selected extensions, t(m), the least i with m ≤ r(i), is monotone and onto since t(r(i))=i. Its fibers are nonempty finite intervals, bounded above by r(i). Apply systemBlockRepetition on the three small étale sites, with these blocks. Its actual repetition functors have exactly the sections, maps and restrictions required in CofinalRepeat. Apply the geometric block square to proper direct image and the section-normalized open-extension square to extension by zero. The exact endpoint left adjoint makes repetition on the compactification preserve K-injective complexes. This constructs CofinalRepeatSupport without using a right adjoint of compact support. The repeated tower is D_m=B_(r(t(m))), with its actual quotient map cofinalCoefficient B r to B. Repetition followed by ordinary coefficient extension has at m the same tensor and transitions as the selected ordinary extension. Both are left adjoints of actual cofinal restriction, with units x↦1⊗x at selected sections. Ordinary adjoint uniqueness with that unit gives ordinary and ordinary_unit in each CofinalFactor. On simultaneous flat-term K-flat representatives the two functors compute the same strict complex, including its transitions and maps. The universal normalized left derived comparison gives derived and its displayed normalization. Acyclic K-flat cones extend the normalization to all complexes via the universal counit. Apply this construction on X and Y. Evaluate repetition to obtain x and y. The ordinary tensor-unit equality, localized with the normalized universal cochain comparison, gives factorX and factorY. On ordinary open complexes the repetition square is identity on sections; on K-injective proper representatives its derived square is the identical complex at t(m). Universal derived uniqueness gives support, the repetition/support evaluation diagram, on all derived objects. No selected-extension/support comparison or its evaluation is asserted.
